title: Brik Deploy Profile v1
description: Contract for the deploy profiles bundled under lib/rollout/data/deploy-profiles/ and merged into a user's brik.yml by rollout.profile.merge (lib/rollout/profile.sh). v1 captures the 3 builtin profiles shipped (trunk-based, github-flow, git-flow) plus the 'none' profile (no deploy block). A profile declares a deploy.environments map: each environment carries a `when` expression, a `target` enum aligned with lib/deployments/, and a Kubernetes-like `namespace`. The target enum mirrors brik.yml schema (schemas/config/v1/brik.schema.json) -- argocd is reached via target=gitops, not as a standalone target.

environments.description: Map of environment-name -> environment-spec. Builtin profile environment names currently observed: dev, staging, production, preview. The key is a free-form lowercase identifier; the value is a typed environment block.

when.description: Condition expression that activates this environment. v0.6.0 uses simple branch/tag matchers like "branch == 'main'", "branch =~ 'feature/*'", "tag =~ 'v*'". The expression is consumed verbatim by the rollout.profile resolver -- the schema does not pin its grammar in v1.

target.description: Deploy target module under lib/deployments/. Mirrors brik.yml schema (schemas/config/v1/brik.schema.json). 'argocd' is reached via target=gitops -- not exposed as a standalone v1 target.

namespace.description: Namespace into which the target deploys. Semantics depend on target: Kubernetes namespace for k8s/helm/gitops, compose project name for compose, identifier for ssh.
